title_vi: Trường hợp kỳ lạ của bác sĩ Jekyll và ông Hyde
translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Utterson uses anh/tôi with Enfield, Jekyll, Lanyon and Guest; Poole and Guest say thưa ông; Utterson calls Poole anh.
decisions.rationale: Victorian gentlemen’s equality and servant deference.

decisions.decision: Jekyll’s statement uses Vietnamese Bible wording: chi thể, đền tạm, Phi-líp, thành ẩn náu, xé toạc từ trên chí dưới, bị cân thấy thiếu.
The witness’s date inconsistency (10 December / 9 January), cut-off sentences and ‘distress of wind’ (read as mind) are kept or minimally read, not harmonised.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: Enfield’s generic ‘one of your fellows who do what they call good’ no longer links Utterson’s own circle to the cheque-signer.
Carew’s ‘well-founded self-content’ no longer pejorative; the body is not yet a corpse; Guest as ‘a man of counsel’ no longer scheming (141).
Room and term names unified across drafting parts (dissecting-room, theatre, court).
Calques in the door scene, ‘let our name be vengeance’, ‘my days are numbered’, ‘compounded the elements’, ‘capacious measure’ and ‘four days ago’ recast; chapter 10 title rephrased.
Biblical echoes restored (veil rent from top to bottom; found wanting); ‘ape-like tricks’ regains menace; notebook ‘double’ as kép.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: phòng làm việc riêng / phòng thí nghiệm / giảng đường giải phẫu / phòng mổ xác
glossary.rationale: The geography of Jekyll’s house matters to the plot; each room keeps one name in all three drafting parts.
Fixed pharmacological vocabulary through Lanyon’s narrative and Jekyll’s statement.

glossary.draft_rendering: ông Hyde / hắn; Jekyll speaking fondly of him: cậu ta
glossary.rationale: Narration and witnesses mark Hyde as hắn; Jekyll’s indulgent cậu ta in chapter 3 turns to hắn after the murder.

witness_decision: Selected the complete text of Project Gutenberg #42 (first published by Longmans, Green & Co., 1886). Gutenberg does not identify the printed edition transcribed; not collated with a print facsimile. Chapter titles are kept as text units.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Poole’s and the maid’s dialect markers are largely standardised.
The Hyde/Seek name pun is rendered by sense (chơi trốn / chơi tìm) without the name play.

title_review.source_title: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
title_review.target_title: Trường hợp kỳ lạ của bác sĩ Jekyll và ông Hyde
title_review.rationale: Trường hợp kỳ lạ của bác sĩ Jekyll và ông Hyde keeps both senses of Stevenson’s Case, medical and legal; the familiar short form is Bác sĩ Jekyll và ông Hyde.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Utterson’s portrait and Enfield’s door story keep their dry humour.
Final sentence of Jekyll’s statement rendered with full weight.
